headline: Red recovery morning and no session on the board — take the rest, arrive at Monday's build week fresh.
body_state: The deterministic verdict is **red**, readiness **29.6 (low)**, and the driver is sleep. **HRV is below your personal 7-day band** — the single strongest hold-intensity signal, and HRV-guided athletes gain ~8% more by respecting it. On top: **22h of 14-day sleep debt**, last night **6.5h**; **Body Battery 33** (under 40, quality underperforms); **RHR 52 vs 46–47 baseline** (+5, an early warning); Garmin training status **Strained**, overtraining **caution**. Nothing is a crisis alone, but stacked they all say the same thing — don't add stress today.
session: **No workout is scheduled today** — you're between the Week 4 cutback (ended Friday) and Week 5, which opens Monday with **easy + strides → progressive → 11km long run** (VO2/threshold build). On a red morning with an empty board, the right move is **rest, or 20–30 min truly easy**. If you move at all: **slow edge ~5:00/km (4:35–5:03 window), HR under 146 (75% max)**, conversational, watch quiet. Don't invent volume to make up Friday's missed long run — banking recovery now is what lets Monday's first build session land.
recent: Your last real run was **Wed 7/22, treadmill**: green volume (5.5km) but **4:28/km — 9–12s under the easy window**, closing at **77% max in the grey zone**. Thursday was a 46-min **indoor cardio block that carries no load** unless you rate it. You haven't run since. Week 4's **5K time trial and 6km long run both show incomplete** — the cutback quietly emptied out. **Grey-zone middle-intensity is limiter #1** (17.5% easy vs the 80% polarised target). The fix is boring and free: when you resume, easy means easy.
focus: Protect recovery today — sleep 60 min earlier, hydrate, no made-up mileage; let Monday's build start from a real base
When you resume, run the SLOW edge (~5:00/km), HR under 146 — kill the grey zone before the VO2/threshold weeks demand it
Rate the indoor cardio with an RPE so it counts toward load instead of vanishing
